messages:
Morgan: Quick design review — embedding & reranking tab prototype ready for feedback. Focus areas: batch input UX, vectors preview (mini-visualization), relevance table (sort/filter/export), and accessibility nits. Fig pinned: https://figma.com/file/XYZ-emb-rerank :eyes:

Aaron: Thanks — high level looks great. Two product things: bulk upload CSV + sample size selection for rerank jobs (10/100/1000). Also need a clear pricing hint when they choose large batches (link to billing).

Jamie: UI notes after a skim: 1) Batch input flow should show progress per-item with speed estimates. 2) Vectors preview: prefer a compact card list with toggle to open a detailed vector inspector. 3) Relevance table: inline score color bar + sort by score, latency, and model.

Sana: Accessibility checklist: keyboard focus order must follow the batch flow (file -> mapping -> preview -> start). Add aria-live region for job progress updates. Color contrast: the green score highlight fails AA at small sizes — suggest darker #0B875B. Also ensure CSV export button has descriptive label (e.g., "Export relevance as CSV (includes vectors?)").

Lee: ML perspective: for vector preview, please avoid rendering full 768-d vectors client-side for large batches. Show top-5 nearest neighbors, a small sparklines view of norm over time, and an option to download raw vectors. For reranking, include which model/version and quantization used in the result row.

Priya: Copy tweaks: header "Embeddings & Reranking" -> consider "Embeddings, Search & Rerank" (users look for search). On the batch upload modal, change: "Upload file" -> "Upload CSV or JSONL (one query per line)". For empty-state: add quick links to sample datasets and a one-click demo job.

Morgan: @Jamie on progress per-item — do you mean per-row progress bar or aggregate with expandable rows? I worry per-row will be noisy for 1k items.

Jamie: Aggregate with per-sample drilldown. Show thumbnails for first 10 and an expandable list for errors. Use a single progress bar + small "processed / total" label. Expand opens a light panel.

Aaron: UX question for export: Should export include raw vector floats by default, or provide two modes: "Summary (scores + ids)" and "Raw vectors (CSV/NDJSON)"? We need to avoid accidentally encouraging huge downloads.

Sana: Two-mode is best. Make "Raw vectors" behind a toggle that warns about file size. Also ensure exported files have proper lang and encoding headers.

Lee: For raw vector downloads, prefer NDJSON gzipped by default for large jobs. Example export header suggestion in file: 
```json
{"id":"123","query":"how to connect db","score":0.82,"vector_length":768}

{"id":"124","query":"db connection pool","score":0.79,"vector":[0.003,...]}
```

Priya: Relevance table columns proposal: [Rank, ID, Query, Score (bar + numeric), Model, Latency, Vector Norm, Actions]. Action menu: View vector, Download row, Rerun with prompt tweak.

Morgan: Performance/UX trade: lazy-load vectors preview only when the inspector panel opens. For table rows, compute a cheap approximate score for initial sort (sampling) then replace with exact after full rerank completes. Thoughts?

Lee: Sounds right. We should surface a badge when score is approximate. Also cache KV prefix embeddings per-user to accelerate repeated reruns.

Jamie: Visual proposal for the relevance bar: small horizontal mini-bar inside the score cell, color-coded with aria-label like "Score 0.82 out of 1.0". That covers screen readers.

Sana: Confirm that the mini-bar has at least 4:1 contrast against the cell background. If using color alone, add numeric fallback and aria-hidden decorative glyphs.

Morgan: A11y + copy action items: @Sana to write short accessibility checklist and example aria text; @Priya to finalize copy strings for modals and export labels; @Jamie to push an updated figma with keyboard states and progress aggregate; @Lee to add backend notes about NDJSON gz export and per-user cache. I'll sync with @Aaron for billing hint placement.

Aaron: FYI — we should add a small billing tooltip near "Start rerank" that estimates token/compute cost for the selected sample size. Minimal, non-blocking.

Priya: Quick copy proposal for billing tooltip: "Estimated compute: ~0.03 vCPU-min per item (depends on model). Charges apply to each rerank job — see pricing docs." Link to /pricing.

Jamie: I'll mock keyboard-only flow and the expanded error list tonight. Putting a note to avoid hover-only controls for the vector inspector.

Sana: I'll also run a quick NVDA test on the modal before the review.

Morgan: Thanks — goal is to ship a beta of this tab in the next sprint. Can we do a short async review thread with screenshots before the design sync on Thursday? Please drop screenshots here when ready. :thumbsup:

designbot: New task created <#design-board-456> "Embeddings & Rerank UI — accessibility + export" assigned to Jamie, Sana, Priya, Lee. Due: 3 days.

Jamie: Uploaded updated figma frames with keyboard flow: https://figma.com/file/XYZ-emb-rerank?node-id=234. Feedback welcome.

Priya: Left microcopy suggestions on the frames. Small note: empty-state CTA text: "Try with sample data" -> prefer "Run demo job" for clarity.

Morgan: Great, thanks everyone. Closing thread for now — will reopen with screenshots.
